run_pipeline_image2video: run the MotifVideoImage2VideoPipeline to generate a video from a single input image and text prompt
encode_prompt_text: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the T5Gemma2Encoder and tokenizer
prepare_first_frame_conditioning: prepare first frame conditioning tensors including latent condition, latent mask, and image embeddings for image-to-video
calculate_scheduler_shift: calculate the shift parameter for the scheduler based on video sequence length for timestep spacing
retrieve_scheduler_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from custom timesteps, sigmas, or num_inference_steps
